where: Prop. 5.5 (ii), last line before (5.5.1): 'le groupe des classes d'extensions commutatives de P par G_k est donné par un isomorphisme canonique'
scan: de P par G_k est donné par un isomorphisme
note: The constant group of the statement is Z_k, and (5.5.1) just below reads Ext^1(P,Z_k); no G is defined. Same slip of G for Z as on pp. 283-285. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: Prop. 5.5 (ii), 'par exemple si Φ est fini p.ex. Z de type fini'
scan: par exemple si Φ est fini p.ex. Z de type fini,
note: Φ = P/P^o is finite when P is of finite type, the example given for 'Φ de torsion' at the start of (ii); the group Z plays no part in the finiteness of Φ, and the proof (p. 283) uses only that n kills Φ. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: first paragraph, '(On se rappelera qu'un schéma en groupes localement de type fini ...)'
note: Spelling error of the typescript (rappeler doubles the l before a mute e). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: after the display P×P → Φ×Φ: 'La description VII 1.1.6 des extensions ... (et VII 1.3 dans le cas d'extensions commutatives)'
scan: (et VII 1.3 dans le cas d'extensions commutatives)
note: The same argument on p. 281 cites 'VII 1.1.6 et 1.2'. In Exposé VII, 1.2 is 'Cas commutatif' (commutative extensions described by a torsor on P with the commutativity condition (1.2.1)); 1.3 is 'Relations avec les torseurs rigidifiés ou birigidifiés'. Probably a wrong reference number; to review. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'Bornons nous maintenant au cas des extensions commutatives'
note: Imperative with enclitic pronoun: the hyphen is missing in the typescript. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'Alors le groupe des automorphismes d'une extension de P par G_k est le groupe'
scan: d'une extension de P par G_k est le groupe
note: These are the extensions of P by Z_k of 5.5 (ii); G for Z as on p. 282. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
Both G_k stand for Z_k: the group is null when Φ is torsion because Z is torsion-free. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: 'On a de même, si V = G⊗_ℤ ℚ , et lorsque Φ est fini'
note: V is the middle term Z⊗_ℤ ℚ of (5.5.2), whose cobord gives (5.5.1). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: Cor. 5.6, 'P et Q deux schémasen groupes commutatifs'

note: Missing word space in the typescript. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: Cor. 5.6, 'Φ = P/P^o et Ψ = Q/Q^o les groupes des composantes neutres'
note: P/P^o is the group of connected components (5.5: 'le groupe des composantes connexes'); P^o is the neutral component. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
The sentence introducing (5.6.1) concerns the biextensions of (P,Q) by Z_k; same slip of G for Z. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
